original_intent: 离线示例需求：设计一个纯函数 normalize_labels，输入 UTF-8 字符串数组，按 Unicode 空白 trim，丢弃空字符串，按大小写敏感的完全相等去重，并保留第一次出现的顺序。非字符串元素使整个调用失败并返回元素索引；不做部分写入。返回字符串数组，不发请求、不存数据、不新增 UI。设计边界为 reviewed_design；本练习只写当前任务产物，不修改仓库。
background: Design normalize_labels as an offline pure function. Existing bound intent supplies no implementation language or authenticated runtime evidence.
impact: Callers receive a stable, deduplicated label array, or a whole-call type error identifying an offending input element.
goal: Specify the original normalization, validation and no-side-effect behavior without implementing it.

conditions.input_domain: An array whose string elements represent UTF-8 text; non-string elements must be detected.
conditions.output_domain: Success: a string array. Failure: no success array and the offending element index.
conditions.runtime: Language-neutral conceptual design; no runtime, dependency, CI, deployment or approval is claimed.
conditions.side_effects: No requests, persistence, UI, repository mutation or partial writes.
conditions.input_limits: No numeric input limit is asserted; the upstream small-bounded-array description does not establish one.

alternatives.approach: Validate element types in input order, then trim/filter/stably deduplicate with a membership set and output array.
benefits: Detects the earliest non-string before building the result
costs: A set plus the output array require auxiliary memory

alternatives.approach: One traversal with a local candidate array and set; discard all local work if a non-string is encountered.
benefits: Can satisfy whole-call failure if the candidate never escapes
costs: Normalizes valid prefixes before detecting a later type error
Requires an explicit rule preventing partial result exposure

alternatives.approach: Validate first, then deduplicate by scanning the accumulated output array.
costs: Repeated equality scans grow quadratically with distinct labels

selection.rationale: It expresses validation and result construction as separate stages while retaining exact case-sensitive equality and original order.
selection.technology: Conceptual array, Unicode-whitespace trim predicate, exact-equality set and local output array. No repository language, framework or library has been selected.
selection.approval: Proposed design only; no same-version material approval exists in the bound inputs.

module_flow: Inspect every element in increasing input-index order for the string type.
On the first non-string, return a whole-call error with its index; return no normalized array.
For a valid string array, trim only Unicode whitespace at the two ends of each element.
Discard a trimmed value if it is empty.
Append a nonempty value only if it has not already appeared after trimming, then mark it seen.
Return the accumulated string array in first-occurrence order.

requirement_trace.design_rule: Trim only the leading and trailing Unicode-whitespace sequences.

requirement_trace.raw_clause: 大小写敏感的完全相等去重
requirement_trace.design_rule: Use exact equality on trimmed strings; do not case-fold or Unicode-normalize.

requirement_trace.raw_clause: 保留第一次出现的顺序
requirement_trace.design_rule: Use a membership set for detection and an array for output order; never sort.

requirement_trace.raw_clause: 非字符串元素使整个调用失败并返回元素索引
requirement_trace.design_rule: Fail for the earliest non-string input element; no success array accompanies the error.
Keep input unchanged and construct only local results; publish a result only after full validation and processing.

requirement_trace.raw_clause: 返回字符串数组，不发请求、不存数据、不新增 UI
requirement_trace.design_rule: Success is only a string array and the function has no external side effects.

material_decisions_for_review.decision: Use zero-based error indices and report the first non-string when several exist.
material_decisions_for_review.reason: The raw request requires an element index but does not specify its base or multiple-error selection.

material_decisions_for_review.decision: Bind Unicode-whitespace trim to an explicit, versioned predicate when an implementation target is selected.
material_decisions_for_review.reason: The current inputs do not identify a runtime or Unicode version; an arbitrary language default must not redefine the raw rule.

evidence.value: 设计边界为 reviewed_design；本练习只写当前任务产物，不修改仓库。

boundary_conflict.interpretation: The declared intake boundary conflicts with the original design-only requirement. The existing contract is retained verbatim as evidence; it is not accepted as deployment authority.
boundary_conflict.recovery: Reconcile the completion boundary with reviewed_design through an explicitly versioned intake/intent correction, preserving the original files and rerunning bindings. Do not silently rewrite upstream artifacts or create downstream artifacts.
